system.name: ParetoPO
system.one_liner: Two-stage multi-objective RL for tool-using LLM agents: hypervolume-guided dynamic scalarization, then Pareto-ranking advantages, to trade accuracy against tool-use efficiency.

content.variant_note: an illustrative accuracy-efficiency plane in which the two method stages are coloured trajectories relative to the frontier and its convex hull
content.argues: Stage 1 (dynamic scalarization) covers the convex hull; Stage 2 (Pareto ranking) then reaches non-convex Pareto-stationary points that linear weighting cannot.
content.subject: Accuracy-efficiency plane with the true Pareto frontier, its convex hull, and the green Stage 1 and purple Stage 2 trajectories.

lessons.what_to_learn: Explain a multi-stage optimiser on one illustrative objective plane: draw the target set (frontier), what the baseline can reach (convex hull) and each stage as a differently coloured path that starts where the previous one ends, with tinted pointers beside the stage titles.
lessons.suits: optimisation or multi-objective learning methods whose stages move through a trade-off space, where the geometry of reachable versus unreachable points is the argument.

evidence: Figure 1 illustrates trajectories of the two stages in multiobjective optimization.
Stage 1 adopts a dynamic scalarization strategy to generate a diverse set of policies with different trade-offs among objectives.
Two-stage multi-objective RL: Accuracy vs. Efficiency.

summary: ParetoPO aligns tool-using LLM agents under competing objectives such as accuracy and tool-use efficiency in two stages: hypervolume-guided dynamic scalarization, then Pareto-ranking advantage computation. Figure 1 is one illustrative plane with accuracy on the x axis and efficiency on y, without ticks. A glowing blue curve is the true, non-convex Pareto frontier and a dashed orange line is its convex hull; the gap between them is labelled the non-convex region that linear weighting cannot reach. A green zigzag of five weight legs (w1 to w5) climbs from Stage 1 Start to Stage 1 End on the frontier, then a purple path slides down it to a yellow star, the Pareto stationary point. Faint rank contours, gradient-field arrows and a legend with coloured words complete the sketch.
summary_zh: ParetoPO 分两阶段对齐工具型 LLM 智能体：先动态标量化覆盖凸包，再用 Pareto 排序到达非凸区域的驻点。图是一张准确率-效率示意平面：蓝色真前沿、橙色虚线凸包、绿色阶段一折线、紫色阶段二路径与黄色星标。
notes: The two bitmap layers (222 x 134 pt and 159 x 107 pt) lie behind the vector lines; only the gradient ground and soft effects are evident, the exact split between the two is not known. The digits in w1 to w5 are subscript glyphs in the text layer. The caption is only a title; stage roles come from the figure labels, the abstract and the one paragraph that mentions the figure.
